bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 171, Number 128 (Friday, July 25, 2025)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. MAGAZINER:
H.R. 4763.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Article I, Section 8
[Page H3656]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Education and Workforce, and in addition to the Committees on House Administration, Oversight and Government Reform, the Judiciary, and Transportation and Infrastructure, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

bill.title: PTO Act
